title: Class-conditioned rejection under imbalance
setting: Synthetic binary classification (make_classification, 5000 samples, 10 features) with a rare positive class; logistic regression trained on 60%, deferral thresholds calibrated on 20%, and everything measured on a held-out 20% test split. The decision threshold is set to the training prior. Selective prediction defers the most uncertain cases at a target coverage, and the metric is how unevenly minority and majority true-class patients are deferred.

paper.title: When uncertainty quantification fails: structural vulnerabilities and corrections for selective prediction under clinical class imbalance
paper.claim: Global Shannon-entropy deferral systematically defers minority patients under imbalance, while class-conditioned rejection with a threshold-aware ambiguity score balances deferral and protects minority sensitivity.

metric.name: deferral_gap
metric.description: Absolute difference between the minority-class and majority-class deferral rates on the test set at fixed overall target coverage. Lower means less minority exclusion. Diagnostics: per-class deferral rates, minority sensitivity among accepted cases, and balanced accuracy on accepted cases.

factors.name: method
factors.description: global_entropy: one Shannon-entropy threshold for all cases. ccr_entropy: per-predicted-class thresholds on standard entropy. ccr_h_tau: per-predicted-class thresholds on the threshold-aware score H_tau (entropy of probability warped so tau maps to 0.5).

factors.name: minority_frac
factors.description: Proportion of the minority (positive) class in the data.

factors.name: coverage
factors.description: Target fraction of cases accepted for automatic prediction (the rest are deferred).

factors.name: class_sep
factors.description: make_classification class separation; lower means more overlapping, ambiguous classes.
